groups.label: U.S. States & D.C.
groups.description: The 50 states and the District of Columbia. U.S. territories remain separately selectable places in CPBR Atlas.

groups.label: Canadian Provinces & Territories
groups.description: Canada's 10 provinces and 3 territories as represented in the 2021 Census boundary files.

groups.label: Brazilian States & Federal District
groups.description: Brazil's 26 states and Federal District using IBGE's official federation-unit boundaries.

groups.label: Mexican Federal Entities
groups.description: Mexico's 31 states and Mexico City using INEGI's 2025 state statistical areas.

groups.label: Australian States & Internal Territories
groups.description: Australia's six states, Northern Territory and Australian Capital Territory. External territories remain separate CPBR Atlas places.

groups.label: Argentine Provinces & CABA
groups.description: Argentina's 23 provinces and the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. Disputed and separately selectable South Atlantic and Antarctic areas are excluded from the subdivision interaction geometry.

groups.label: German States (Länder)
groups.description: Germany's 16 constituent states using the federal VG250 Länder boundary layer.

groups.label: Italian Regions
groups.description: Italy's 20 administrative regions using Istat's generalized 2026 boundaries.

groups.label: Japanese Prefectures
groups.description: Japan's 47 prefectures using the official GSI boundary layer. Municipal polygons are dissolved into prefecture outlines, with disputed Northern Territories excluded from interaction geometry.

groups.label: South African Provinces
groups.description: South Africa's nine provinces using MDB-derived boundaries and a roster cross-checked against Statistics South Africa.

groups.label: Swiss Cantons
groups.description: Switzerland's 26 cantons using swisstopo's current swissBOUNDARIES3D canton layer.

groups.label: Austrian States
groups.description: Austria's nine federal states using Statistics Austria's 2026 NUTS-2 boundaries.

groups.label: Spanish Autonomous Communities
groups.description: Spain's 17 autonomous communities using official NUTS 2024 regional geometry. Ceuta and Melilla remain standalone CPBR Atlas places and join Spain only in Sovereign states grouping.

groups.label: Dutch Provinces
groups.description: The Netherlands' 12 provinces using Kadaster's official maintained provincial boundaries.

groups.label: Polish Voivodeships
groups.description: Poland's 16 voivodeships. The two NUTS areas forming Masovian Voivodeship are recombined into its administrative boundary.

groups.label: Colombian Departments & Bogotá
groups.description: Colombia's 32 departments and the Capital District of Bogotá using IGAC's official administrative boundary layers.

groups.label: Chilean Regions
groups.description: Chile's 16 regions using INE's official simplified boundaries. Interaction geometry is limited to administered land and excludes the Antarctic claim.

groups.label: Norwegian Counties
groups.description: Mainland Norway's 15 counties. Svalbard and Jan Mayen remain separate CPBR Atlas places.

groups.label: Swedish Counties
groups.description: Sweden's 21 counties using official NUTS 2024 county-equivalent geometry.

groups.label: New Zealand Regions
groups.description: New Zealand's 16 regional-council areas. The Chatham Islands Territory sits outside the regional-council system and remains a separate CPBR Atlas place.
